checks.sharedPresenter: Both workbench and Harbor invoke RearPresenter after wheel telemetry/spin presentation; common current-asset registry.
checks.affineTransforms: Arm/belt retain authored chassis pivot, align the hub by axial stretch; spring scales axially, rigid body/piston anchor opposite ends. Matrix preservation avoids rotated-stretch decomposition shear.
checks.isolatedUnitExecution: 3/3 rear-presentation tests independently executed, including all supported heights, four spin quarters, reverse sweep, chassis transform, explicit missing-group error.

openEvidence: Group endpoints are nominated coordinates transformed through real group matrices, not yet independently located mesh endpoints. Actual exported geometry and semantic attachment origins must agree.
Actual tire/body/storage intersection tests must cover triangle surfaces, not only sampled vertices or AABB overlap, at all travel extremes, spin quarters, intermediate and prior lap heights.
Check non-spinning axle/caliper geometry physically aligns with the wheel/disc, belt ends remain coherent, and rigid shock sleeves overlap without bottoming or separation across travel.
Need actual daylight enclosed-body and diagnostic views, modes bay/pad/Harbor, and normal braking/motion.
Capture source stability must be paired with served JS/CSS/build-ref verification; served GLB/sidecar alone is insufficient. Parent notified.
limits: Rear geometry candidate was not yet available for this review.
Hardpoints are author estimates, not OEM CAD measurements.
